firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: h1 is 8 words and 3 lines, one primary + a quieter secondary, phone in the header, Sample-labelled proof line, the gable mosaic shows the signature. The hero fills 900px with no next-band peek (-0.5). Duluth sits only in the eyebrow, not the h1. 390-first.jpg: h1 3 lines, both actions above the fold, no image or signature tile above the fold.

distinctiveness.notes: 1440-full.jpg / 390-full.jpg: riser rail and level tags in every section, hero to footer. Services, reviews and prices are organised by house level (1440-scroll-50.jpg, 1440-scroll-75.jpg). Siblings B/C 1440-first.jpg share no face, palette or hero family. Middle-dot meta strings in the hero proof and review bylines (1440-first.jpg).

type.notes: Big Shoulders + Source Sans 3, strong hero scale contrast, en-dash tabular price ranges (1440-scroll-75.jpg). 1440-first.jpg: 4 tiny tracked caps labels in one view (-0.5). 1440-scroll-75.jpg: 'R-' / '60' breaks across lines.

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: 64px rail grid, full-bleed roofline break, dense level list, asymmetric pinned story. 1440-rm-full.jpg: Prices, Season, FAQ, Form and Footer are five night bands in a row and read as one dark block (-0.5). 1440-scroll-50.jpg: single-card level rows leave empty right blocks.

photo.notes: 1440-full.jpg / 390-full.jpg: only one photograph on the whole page (the hero night yard). No sequence, nothing for a grade to unify (-0.5). 1440-first.jpg: the subject is a lamp and a bench, with the house blurred behind trees (-0.5). The gable mask is a good signature treatment. 390-first.jpg: no image above the fold.

copy.notes: 390-full.jpg: specific, plain lines ('Ice dams start in the attic, not the gutters', 'We don't sell one material for the whole house'). Reviews, prices and the guarantee match facts.json and are Sample-labelled (1440-scroll-75.jpg). 1440-scroll-50.jpg: 'Price it' x8 is generic. 1440-scroll-25.jpg: 'Six steps' vs '3 OF 5 SEALED' clash.

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg: h1 3 lines, both CTAs above the fold, sticky Call/Text/Price bar. render.json: no overflow at 320/390. 390-full.jpg: 18,245px, about 21.6 screens, with four tools stacked at full length (-0.5). Hero level tiles shrink to caption-less decoration.

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg show every section's text. 1440-scroll-75.jpg: review bylines are small light grey on sage and look under 4.5:1 (-0.5, verify). 1440-scroll-50.jpg: card blurbs are borderline mid grey.

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: the pinned story works, with step tabs, the active step in amber, a stitch counter and stitched leaks. The rail colour shifts amber to ice (1440-full.jpg vs 1440-scroll-50.jpg). 1440-full.jpg: the pin leaves about 1,900px of empty ink, and each step changes only the tab plus one sentence, so the scrub is thin. The drawing shows no warm-air movement between frames.

wow.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg: the house section stitching shut. 390-full.jpg: the ice-blue roofline break with the one leaking house, plus the heat-path picker (1440-full.jpg). Coherent but not bookmark-level: the all-sealed payoff lands in a static band, not in the story.

polish.notes: 1440-first.jpg: two unlabeled hairlines cut across the hero photo. 1440-full.jpg (#form): stray '\' stitch glyph and a gap in 'STEP 1 OF 4'. 1440-scroll-75.jpg: R-value hyphen break.

elevate.move: Make photography part of the level system: give the story payoff and at least two levels (roof deck, attic or rim joist) real library frames clipped into the same gable / level-cut masks with an ink + ice duotone, so the page reads as one night shoot of one house, top down.

Make the first screen state the whole thesis: Duluth in the h1, the riser visibly leaking ember out of the gable photo's ridge and stitched in ice at the h1, the hero trimmed so the paper L1 band peeks, and one captioned level tile brought above the fold on 390.
